notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for update-rate designator composition across an additional-FOM join. The source uses only the official RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs plus the standard library; the adapter supplies the rich base FOM, additional FOM module, update-rate names, provider package, endpoint, and callback configuration. It does not assert provider-specific handle values, registries, headers, or private configuration.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador createFederationExecution, joinFederationExecution(additionalFomModules), getUpdateRateValue, resignFederationExecution, and destroyFederationExecution
api_surfaces.source_symbol: IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador FOM composition and update-rate lookup declarations
